comment_batch_size: Training batch size from ICML 2022 paper. Paper default: 32
comment_cache_dataset: Cache dataset in memory for faster training
comment_num_workers: Number of parallel data loading workers
comment_train_rate: Training data ratio (60% train, 20% eval, 20% test by default)
comment_scaler: Feature scaling method. Paper uses standard (z-score normalization)
comment_load_external: Whether to load external features (e.g., weather, POI)
comment_input_window: Input sequence length in timesteps (12 timesteps = 1 hour at 5-min intervals)
comment_output_window: Output prediction horizon in timesteps (12 timesteps = 1 hour ahead)
comment_output_dim: Output feature dimension. DSTAGNN uses only traffic_flow (first feature). Set to 1 to select only first column
comment_sparsity: Sparsity parameter for Adaptive Graph (AG) construction. Default: 0.01 (1% connectivity)
comment_period: Number of timesteps in one day. For 5-minute intervals: 288 (24*60/5)
